Services

Lighting for every part of your property

Each design starts with what you want to see at night. We choose the fixtures, set the angles, and light the features that deserve it.

Home & facade lighting

Wash brick, stone, siding, columns and gables with soft light so the architecture stands out after sunset.

Wall washers · Up and down lights

Path & walkway lighting

Low, shielded fixtures along walks, driveways and steps. Guests see where they are going without glare.

Path lights · Step lights

Tree & landscape uplighting

Bring mature oaks, palms and specimen plants into the evening view. Light from below, or from above for a moonlit effect.

Bullet lights · Spotlights

Retaining wall & hardscape

Small lights tucked under wall caps and stone edges. They add a clean line of light and make grade changes easy to read.

Hardscape lights · Wall lights

Patio & entertaining areas

Layered, comfortable light for fire pits, seating and outdoor dining, bright enough to use and soft enough to enjoy.

Wash lights · Downlights

Color & accent lighting

Color-changing fixtures for palms, pool areas and seasonal looks. Switch from warm white to a holiday scene with a tap.

Color-changing LED

Garden & decorative accents

Lanterns, globes and sculptural pieces that give the yard its own focal point, on or off the main lighting circuit.

Decorative lanterns · Globes

Controls, upgrades & service

Timers, dusk-to-dawn sensors and app control. We also repair, re-aim and expand systems that are already in the ground.

Timers · Photocells · Smart control

Why outdoor lighting

More home to enjoy once the sun goes down

Curb appeal

A well-lit front elevation looks finished at night and gives the whole street a better view of your home.

Safer steps and paths

Light placed on stairs, walks and grade changes helps prevent trips for family and guests.

Fewer dark corners

Lit entries, side yards and tree lines leave fewer places that go unseen after dark.

A bigger evening yard

Patios, fire pits and pools become places you actually use on a long summer night.

Low-voltage LED

Efficient fixtures that run on low-voltage wiring and last for years of evenings.

Covered for a year

Every installation carries a one-year warranty, and we come back out if something needs attention.

How it works

From first walk-through to final tune-up

  1. Free consultation

    We walk the property with you and talk about what you want to highlight and how you use the space at night.

  2. Design & quote

    You get a clear plan for fixture types and locations, with a written quote before any work starts.

  3. Installation

    Fixtures and low-voltage wire go in with as little disturbance to your landscape as possible.

  4. Night tune-up

    After dark we adjust aim, brightness and timers so everything looks right at the time you see it.
